## Clinical justification

This patient has three co-existing oral mucosal findings: a non-healing oral ulcer on the left lateral tongue for seven weeks; an adjacent red patch in mouth at the floor of the mouth; and a white patch in mouth on the left floor that cannot be rubbed off and has been present for at least four weeks. He is an ex-smoker with a 30-pack-year smoking history and drinks 20 units per week. The combination of findings requires urgent specialist assessment.
